responsibility: Implements the main GCC backend logic for the TILEPro target. This file owns target hooks for ABI decisions, argument passing and return values, varargs, addressing legitimacy, constant and RTL costs, prologue/epilogue generation, PIC/TLS handling, builtin registration and expansion, branch/compare lowering, multiply-by-constant expansion using the generated tables, scheduling and reorg support, operand printing and bundle-aware asm output, profiling calls, trampolines, and final targetm hook registration, making it the central code-generation and ABI implementation for TILEPro.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the sibling header, machine description, and option table files, this is the executable C implementation that defines TILEPro target hook functions and helper routines, then wires them into targetm. It is where the ABI rules and backend policies declared in tilepro.h, the RTL patterns from tilepro.md, and the switches described in tilepro.opt are actually interpreted and acted on in code.
